content.text: Rim 0.7 only. Move to the south wall? Wait for enemies near wall. Go south.
I'm fighting the fodder near the south wall and using the kills to build a debris ramp. HP is 60 and I have one kill.
I'm holding the south wall and waiting for the next enemies. Kills here should drop debris where I'm standing.
Four enemies close, all low HP. Punch repeatedly.
HP is 4, so I'm nearly dead. I'll attack the weak enemy and hope.

I died in box 1 without escaping any boxes. I got 7 kills (the last two came in my final punches) before the fodder wore my health down to zero.

The debris spread out thin and shrank over time, so the pile against the wall never reached the 0.7 m rim height. I fought with my back to the south wall and took steady hits the whole time because most of my kicks and punches missed.
